footnote_text: On November 12, 2026, the issuer granted to the reporting person a restricted stock award of 629,000 shares under the issuer's Amended and Restated 2019 Stock Incentive Plan. The shares vest only if the issuer's return on equity for fiscal year 2026 exceeds 18%, in which case 50% vest on the date the issuer's audited fiscal year 2026 financial statements are published and 50% vest six months thereafter, subject to the reporting person's continued service. If the condition is not met, all of the shares will be forfeited.

On November 12, 2026, the issuer granted to the reporting person a restricted stock award of 688,000 shares under the issuer's Amended and Restated 2019 Stock Incentive Plan, representing the reporting person's annual awards for fiscal years 2027 and 2028. Of these shares, 344,000 vest in twelve substantially equal quarterly installments beginning January 1, 2027, and 344,000 vest in twelve substantially equal quarterly installments beginning January 1, 2028, in each case subject to the reporting person's continued service. No annual award will be granted to the reporting person for fiscal year 2028.
